title: ח׳ א־דוורה (Kh. ed-Dawara)
author: I. Finkelstein
location_note: Desert fringe north-east of Jerusalem near Mukhmas.
notes: Single-period walled Iron Age site (11th to late 10th or early 9th c. BCE), four-room houses with monolith pillars. No feature of the eligible classes. The 1986 season is coded in phase 2 (ESI06-048-kh-ed-dawara).

features.subtype: rock-cut burial cave with three arcosolia (troughs with headrests) and a bone repository
features.period: second to last quarter of the 4th c. CE
features.quote: המערה שימשה לקבורה בין הרבע השני לרבע האחרון של המאה

title: אתר נחל זמרה (Nahal Zimrah site)
author: O. Yogev
location_note: South bank of Nahal Zimrah, c. 1 km east of Tell el-Ful.
notes: Late Iron Age four-room house and building on terraces; MB I, MB II, late Iron and Hellenistic remains.

features.subtype: bell-shaped plastered rock-cut cistern under a building corner (Area A); three cisterns located on the site
features.quote: נמצא בור מים חצוב דמוי ,פעמון שטוייח בטיח עבה
מחצבה קטנה שבה ניכרים עדיין סימני חציבת

features.subtype: three robbed rock-cut tombs on the north slope
features.quote: נמצאו בסקר שלושה קברים חצובים מן התקופה
כמו כן נתגלה בית בד ,קטן חצוב

title: ירושלים, עיר דוד - 1985 (Jerusalem, City of David - 1985)
author: Y. Shiloh
location_note: City of David, Areas D2 and E1; no map reference.
notes: Hellenistic terraces (not earlier than the end of the 2nd c. BCE) not eligible.

features.subtype: round 'columbarium' structure built on bedrock, divided by a cross wall
features.quote: מבנה הקולומבאריום שייך לשיכבה 9 , מן התקופה

title: ירושלים, הר ציון (Jerusalem, Mount Zion)
author: S. Margalit, B. Pixner
location_note: Upper slope east of the old Protestant cemetery; no map reference.

features.subtype: rock-cut miqveh (excavators' label), white mosaic at the entrance
features.period: Second Temple period; converted to a cistern in the Byzantine period
features.quote: נתגלה מקווה חצוב בסלע מימי בית

features.subtype: the miqveh converted into a water cistern
rock-cut room with two pilasters, plastered bench and small cell
features.period: cut in the First Temple period, refurbished in the Second Temple and Byzantine periods
features.quote: נראה שהחדר נחצב בימי בית ראשון ושופץ בימי בית שני

title: ירושלים, עמק רפאים (Jerusalem, ʿEmeq Refaim)
author: E. Eisenberg, G. Edelstein
location_note: ʿEmeq Refaim site; no map reference.
notes: MB II village of houses on rock terraces and MB I houses; small pits in a courtyard (not described as cisterns). No feature of the eligible classes.
